criteria.title: Focused and operationally useful validation strategy
criteria.description: The recommended tests state observable expected outcomes, use meaningful positive and negative controls from the corpus, and define practical deployment gates while preserving ordinary triage behavior.
evidence_requirements: Cite the delivered file, section, record, or observable behavior for each substantive clause.

Accept equivalent wording or structure only when the requested outcome remains intact.
